searchText: Will this meeting be recorded? It is possible we will add long addresses prior to switching to verkle tries. Overloading the nonce field was the easiest way to do it that was completely agnostic to merkle vs verkle tries. With verkle tries we could add a new field `longAddressTranslation`, but I can't see a way to do that straightforwardly under merkle tries. excerpts.author: peter.davies
excerpts.content: It is possible we will add long addresses prior to switching to verkle tries. Overloading the nonce field was the easiest way to do it that was completely agnostic to merkle vs verkle tries. With verkle tries we could add a new field `longAddressTranslation`, but I can't see a way to do that straightforwardly under merkle tries.
